summary.headline: H1 FY27 revenue rose 78.52% YoY to about INR 75 crore and PAT rose about 54% to INR 9.5 crore, while EBITDA margin fell to 19.45% from 21.38%.
summary.overview: Management reported H1 FY27 (half year ended 30 September 2026) revenue from operations of about INR 75 crore versus INR 42 crore in H1 FY26, with EBITDA of INR 14.6 crore and PAT of INR 9.5 crore. EBITDA and PAT margins both compressed year on year. Management reiterated FY27 revenue guidance of INR 190-200 crore, which implies a steep second-half ramp. Management flagged slow cash conversion, with receivables expected to convert in 45-60 days, and said its 'Other current assets' had risen. The call also covered CBG commissioning, a UAE subsidiary tender, and plans to refinance high-cost NBFC loans.

segments.name: City gas distribution (CGD)
segments.commentary: Revenue of INR 49.67 crore with segment result of INR 10.15 crore in H1 FY27. Management guides CGD PAT margin at about 12.5-13.5% on a conservative basis.

segments.name: Power distribution and solar EPC
segments.commentary: Power distribution revenue of INR 3.89 crore with segment result of INR 48.72 lakh. Management guides solar EPC PAT margin at about 10-11% and power transmission and distribution at 11-12%.

segments.name: General civil construction
segments.commentary: Revenue of INR 21.47 crore with segment result of INR 3.52 crore. Management described the work as piling and solar-related EPC activity, citing a Boisar (Maharashtra) project.

segments.name: Compressed biogas (CBG)
segments.commentary: Early-stage, with a nominal loss of INR 5.09 lakh in H1. Management says a CBG injection into the Adani Total Gas pipeline is expected before Diwali.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance reiterated at approximately INR 190-200 crore; management says H2 (October to March) carries most project activity.
Executable order book cited at about INR 384 crore, versus INR 370 crore+ stated earlier in the call.
Long-term ambition of INR 1,000 crore revenue by FY30, described as dependent on order inflows, execution and market conditions.
Management expects margins to broadly hold, with risk from Middle East geopolitics and abnormal price rises.
Expects CBG injection into the Adani Total Gas pipeline before Diwali; UAE (ADNOC, Ras Al Khaimah) tender price-bid opening expected within 2-3 months.
Plans to close high-cost NBFC business loans (cited at 16-17%) by about 15 December; the timeline was misstated as 2027 on the call.
capex_capacity: Project size capability now INR 50 crore+; infra projects completed about INR 340 crore (stated in H1).
CBG plant at early stage; pilot ran for 60 days with a stated 97-98% capacity; commercial injection expected before Diwali.
Management says the state-level CBG subsidy is still being drafted in most states, and it is awaiting declaration.
Working capital facilities include cash bill discounting and trade payable limits used on roughly 90-day cycles; a recent loan limit increase to INR 150 crore was mentioned.
demand_pricing: Tender pipeline stated at INR 740 crore+; conversion ratio 'conservatively' 30-40%, implying INR 250-300 crore of awards.
Growth drivers cited: PNG adoption push by PNGRB/MoPNG, the 500 GW renewable target for 2030, and water infrastructure.
Management says margins have not fallen much despite Middle East disruption, citing 3.5 decades in the industry.
Management is monitoring crude-linked material price, logistics and procurement cost risk from the Middle East conflict.

qa_highlights.question: Why does H1 growth look lower than the 70-80% growth earlier guided?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated FY27 revenue guidance of INR 190-200 crore, citing a natural execution cycle with most activity in H2 (Oct-Mar) and an executable order book of about INR 384 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Will the GOBARDHAN scheme help CBG plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the central subsidy will benefit the company long term, but state-level subsidies are still pending in most states.

qa_highlights.question: Is operating cash flow on track to turn positive?
qa_highlights.answer: Management acknowledged the concern and said the next priority is converting growth into cash through better working capital management; no figures were given.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the UAE subsidiary and green hydrogen sales?
qa_highlights.answer: Desco Global participated in an ADNOC tender for Ras Al Khaimah; price-bid opening is awaited within 2-3 months. Management said commercial sales are being prepared, with a pilot completed.

qa_highlights.question: Will high-interest NBFC loans be refinanced below 10%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said business loans taken in 2024 at high rates will be closed by about 15 December, with foreclosure charges considered; the trade finance limits will remain.

qa_highlights.question: What margin is expected by segment on a PAT basis?
qa_highlights.answer: CGD about 12.5-13.5%, solar EPC about 10-11%, and power T&D about 11-12%; management said these are conservative PAT margins.

qa_highlights.question: How is the increase in other current assets viewed?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is not a concern; certifications and billings have begun and conversion to cash is expected in 45-60 days.

risks_watch: EBITDA and PAT margins both fell YoY (EBITDA 19.45% vs 21.38%; PAT 12.66% vs 14.68%) despite revenue growth.
Cash conversion remains unproven: management gave no operating cash flow figure, and other current assets rose significantly.
FY27 guidance of INR 190-200 crore needs about INR 115-125 crore of revenue in H2 versus about INR 75 crore in H1.
CBG commercial injection and the state-level CBG subsidy are both pending; management has repeatedly said timelines are uncertain.
Management repeatedly cited an unconfirmed 'before Diwali' timeline and a 15 December loan refinancing target.
Middle East geopolitics, crude-linked input costs, and the UAE tender outcome remain open.
summary.management_tone: Management was upbeat and confident on growth and the long-term vision, with frequent references to national priorities. Answers on cash flow, margins and timelines were often vague, and several were not backed by figures. The management also gave multiple inconsistent or unclear figures and dates in the call, and the transcript has audibility issues.

tone.note: Management was confident on growth, the order book and the long-term INR 1,000 crore FY30 ambition, but was vague on cash flow, margin figures and CBG and loan timelines. Analysts pushed on why H1 growth fell short of the 70-80% previously guided and on the margin decline.
